lines.en: - Who's Chip? - I was a good run into you at the bank today.
- Chip is Chip Matthews. - The guy who took Rachel to the prom?
- 'Cause I ran into him at the bank. He is still so cute.
- Monica, you're so lucky. He's, like, the most popular guy in school!
- I know! - Chip, hi. It's Monica.
Oh, my God. We just had the best conversation.
- 'Cause I've got a product report to read.
It's, like, eight pages. I hope I don't fall asleep.
- Well, uh, actually... - I bet he sensed
that I was ready to have sex with another guy.
Why don't you give him a call?
- Are you sure you want to hear this?
Yeah, um, you left me a message?
Yes, you did. My roommate wrote it down.
He called to ask out Monica.
